en.headline: No. 3 alarm fire at Yuen Long paper offerings warehouse leaves 12 evacuated
en.dek: Firefighters brought a blaze at a Pak Sha Tsuen warehouse under control early Saturday after it was upgraded to No. 3 alarm; no injuries were reported.
body: The Fire Services Department said a fire broke out at a warehouse storing paper funeral offerings in Pak Sha Tsuen, Yuen Long, at 10.58pm on Friday.

The blaze was upgraded to a No. 3 alarm at 11.25pm. Firefighters used three jets and three breathing apparatus teams. The fire was surrounded at 1.05am on Saturday, put under control at 1.51am and largely extinguished at 2.39am, according to the department.
Twelve people self-evacuated to places of safety. No casualties have been reported. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 元朗白沙村紙紮倉庫三級火 12人自行疏散無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處指周五晚上白沙村一間存放紙紮品的倉庫起火，凌晨升級至三級火警後於今早受控，無人受傷。
body: 消防處表示，元朗白沙村一間存放紙紮祭品的倉庫於周五晚上10時58分起火。
火警於11時25分升級為三級火警。消防員出動三條喉及三隊煙火特遣隊。火勢於周六凌晨1時05分被包圍，1時51分受控，2時39分大致撲滅。
12人自行疏散至安全地方。當局指無人受傷，火警原因仍在調查中。
